title: Archeological Technician (Seasonal) — National Park Service
summary: Archeological Technicians perform technical archeological work to identify, document, investigate, and preserve cultural resources through field surveys, excavation, artifact processing, data management, and basic research. The typical season is April - November, but can be variable during these months due to weather conditions, project needs, or funding. Anticipated Entry on Duty: April - May 202

title: Archeologist (Seasonal) — National Park Service
summary: Serves as a cultural resources specialist for one or more parks where archeological resources comprise a major part of the park story. The park may be one where archeological resources are predominant, or where natural resources are predominant but where significant archeological resources are present. Anticipated Entry on Duty: April-May 2027. Open to the first 125 applicants or until 11/02/2026

title: Motor Vehicle Operator (Seasonal) — National Park Service
summary: The typical season is May through November but can be variable during these months due to weather conditions, project needs, or funding. Some positions filled may be covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Anticipated Entry on Duty: April - May 2027 Work schedule is dependent on the position. · $20–$27 per hour

title: Motor Vehicle Operator (Seasonal) — National Park Service
summary: The typical seasonal entry-on-duty period is March through October, but can be variable during these months due to weather conditions, project needs, or funding. Anticipated Entry on Duty: March to May2027 Must possess and maintain a current Class B or higher Commercial Driver's License, with Air Brakes endorsement by the closing date of this announcement Work schedule is dependent on the position

title: Great Basin National Park: No Potable Water in Park Campgrounds
summary: There is no water available in any campground in Great Basin National Park. Water is available at the Great Basin Visitor Center and the Lehman Caves Visitor Center.

title: Great Basin National Park: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive Winter Closure
summary: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive is closed to vehicle traffic at the Wheeler Peak Summit Trailhead due to winter weather.

title: Biologist (Seasonal) — National Park Service
summary: You will serve as a Biologist (Seasonal) .The position intended to assist staff with Biological field work and compliance tasks. Anticipated Entry on Duty: April or May 2027. Open to the first 100 applicants or until 11/03/2026 whichever comes first. Housing may be available. Work schedule is dependent on the position · $30–$38 per hour

title: Great Basin National Park
summary: From the 13,063-foot summit of Wheeler Peak to the sagebrush-covered foothills, Great Basin National Park hosts a sample of the incredible diversity of the larger Great Basin region. Come and partake of the solitude of the wilderness, walk among ancient bristlecone pines, bask in the darkest of night skies, and explore mysterious subterranean passages. There's a lot more than just desert here.
